question: Choose the drug which blocks basal as well as stimulated gastric acid secretion without affecting cholinergic, histaminergic or gastrin receptors
analysis: The drug that blocks basal as well as stimulated gastric acid secretion without affecting cholinergic, histaminergic, or gastrin receptors is a proton pump inhibitor (PPI). Among the options provided, Omeprazole is a PPI that acts by irreversibly inhibiting the hydrogen/potassium adenosine triphosphatase enzyme system (proton pump) of the gastric parietal cells.
